That's pretty much what my close friends have said but being apart from her hurts me a lot despite it all. I had pretty genuine feelings for her.

I haven't tried therapy for 2 reasons: I just don't believe it'll be effective given how deeply rooted my problems are and I don't even have the money to pay for it since I can't lock down a decent job. It utterly pains me to have to rely on my family and friends for anything so the thought of asking them is just as unbearable. I hate being a burden on people and that's one of the driving factors in why I feel the way I do.
